parsed.summary: The PR introduces a change to handle encoding more robustly but may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change introduces a new default behavior by using `r.apparent_encoding` when `r.encoding` is `None`. This could lead to unexpected behavior if `r.apparent_encoding` is incorrect or if it changes the behavior of existing code that relies on `r.encoding` being `None`.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of the change. This increases the risk of regressions or unintended side effects.
